subject: SolVista — initial discovery & scheduling
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@solvista.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Intro & discovery: SolVista x Redwood - scheduling initial call

Hi Elena —

Thanks for taking the initial intro with me last week. I wanted to loop in Priyom (solutions lead) and Marissa (our SE) to coordinate an initial discovery / intake call so we can:

- Confirm technical owners and scope (inference workloads, data flows)
- Surface compliance/security needs up front (SOC2, data residency)
- Align on procurement timeline and next steps

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed Aug 31: 9:00–10:00 or 10:30–11:30
- Thu Sep 1: 14:00–15:00 or 15:30–16:30

If you can confirm which slot works and who from your engineering/security/procurement teams should join, we’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. I’ve attached a 1‑page discovery agenda for context.

Calendar (optional): https://calendly.com/redwood/solvista-discovery

Thanks — look forward to aligning.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: discovery-agenda.pdf

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@solvista.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@solvista.com>, procurement@solvista.com, security@solvista.com
Date: 2027-08-29T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery: SolVista x Redwood - scheduling initial call

Karthik —

Thanks — Rajiv (eng lead) and I reviewed your note. We can do a 60‑minute discovery. Our initial availability (PT):
- Wed Aug 31: 09:00–11:00 (any time in that window)
- Thu Sep 1: 14:00–16:00

I’ve cc’d Rajiv and procurement/security. Ideally Rajiv (or their engineering designee) + our procurement rep join. Security would like to see a SOC2 summary prior to the call if possible. Can you share a short artifact?

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Director, Product | SolVista
elena@solvista.com

(added: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@solvista.com>, procurement@solvista.com, security@solvista.com)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@solvista.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@solvista.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@solvista.com, security@solvista.com
Date: 2027-08-29T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery: SolVista x Redwood - scheduling initial call

Elena —

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping Rajiv and procurement/security. We can share a short SOC2 summary and a one‑pager on our data retention practices ahead of the call — attaching both here for your security team to review.

Let’s lock Thu Sep 1 at 14:00 PT (60 minutes) unless Rajiv prefers the earlier Aug 31 window. Agenda (short):
- 10 mins intros + success criteria
- 20 mins architecture & expected workload patterns (Rajiv + Marissa)
- 20 mins security/compliance discussion (Marissa + security)
- 10 mins next steps + procurement cadence (Karthik)

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/1345

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, data-retention-overview.pdf

If anyone needs a different time, we can pivot — happy to propose alternatives.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@solvista.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@solvista.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@solvista.com
Date: 2027-08-30T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & discovery: SolVista x Redwood - scheduling initial call

Priyom / Elena —

Thanks for the materials, Priyom. Quick note — Sep 1 afternoon is tricky for me due to an internal rollout. I can do
- Fri Sep 2: 09:00–11:30 PT or
- Wed Aug 31: 10:00–11:00 PT (if you can push earlier)

Also looping in Amina (our cloud security engineer) — Amina, would you join the discovery? I’d also ask that Redwood share the security questionnaire ahead of time so Amina can pre‑triage.

—Rajiv
Rajiv Patel
VP Engineering | SolVista
rajiv.patel@solvista.com

Subject: Re: Intro & discovery: SolVista x Redwood - scheduling initial call

Rajiv / Elena —

Thanks — I can do Fri Sep 2 at 10:00 PT. I’ll plan to run the architecture portion and lead the security/compliance section. If Amina can join, great — otherwise I’ll walk through our SOC2 summary + what the typical evidence and timelines look like.

I’m attaching a blank security questionnaire template you can fill out and send back before the call; that helps us keep the discussion concrete. Also happy to do a short 20‑minute technical deep‑dive immediately after the discovery if we want to validate model sizing and latency expectations.

Attachment: security-questionnaire-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

All —

Confirming Fri Sep 2 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team. Amina will join for security. Procurement will follow up separately on PO/timing.

Please send a calendar invite and call link; we’ll review the attached docs ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Elena
